input:
If ā = î + ĵ, b̄ = 2ĵ - k̂ and r̄ × ā = b̄ × ā, r̄ × b̄ = ā × b̄, then the value r̄ / |r̄| is

Options:
A. (î + 3ĵ + k̂)/√11
B. (î - 3ĵ + k̂)/√11
C. (î - 3ĵ - k̂)/√11
D. (î + 3ĵ - k̂)/√11

phase_1_understand_the_problem.problem_restatement: Find the unit vector r̄ / |r̄| given ā = î + ĵ, b̄ = 2ĵ - k̂, and cross product relations r̄ × ā = b̄ × ā and r̄ × b̄ = ā × b̄.
phase_1_understand_the_problem.key_observation: (r̄ - b̄) × ā = 0 means r̄ - b̄ is parallel to ā, so r̄ = b̄ + tā. Substitute into second relation to find t, determine r̄, and compute unit vector.

key_concepts: Parallel vectors cross product: u × v = 0 ⇒ u = t v

key_formulas.substitute_in_rel2: (r̄ - ā) × b̄ = 0  ⇒  (t-1)î + (1+t)ĵ - k̂ is parallel to b̄ = 2ĵ - k̂

phase_3_plan_the_approach.strategy: Express r̄ = b̄ + tā, use the second condition to solve for t, write down r̄, compute its magnitude, and evaluate r̄ / |r̄|.
logical_steps: Step 1: From (r̄ - b̄) × ā = 0, write r̄ = b̄ + tā = tî + (2+t)ĵ - k̂
Step 3: From (r̄ - ā) × b̄ = 0, set cross product of (r̄ - ā) with (0, 2, -1) to 0
Step 4: Solve for t: x = 1, y = 3, z = -1 ⇒ r̄ = î + 3ĵ - k̂
Step 6: Unit vector = (î + 3ĵ - k̂)/√11 and match option D
